proof-statement-integrity.evidence: This file declared a SECOND class named MassVolumeFactorization - QOU.BraidsKnots.MassVolumeFactorization - with three fields markov_trace : R, jsj_volume_sum : R and factorization_identity : markov_trace = jsj_volume_sum, and ReebBundleComplementEqualsVolume returned that field. It cited AGENTS.md 3b-cond for the pattern while being the case item 5 forbids: both reals are chosen by the instance, so the conditional theorem derives nothing. The conjecture already had a carrier with the shape 3b-cond describes - QOU.ParticleInteractions.MassVolumeFactorization, parameterised over the link configuration K and strand count n, with density/volume/mass as FUNCTIONS on K and factorization quantified over K, so its binder constrains caller data. The two share only a name and different namespaces; measured, nothing imports the BraidsKnots one and mass-volume-factorization.lean imports only Mathlib. Worse, collapsing sum over hyperbolic P_i of rho_F(P_i)*V_hyp(P_i) into one opaque jsj_volume_sum ERASED the JSJ grading, which is what makes this a distinct proposition rather than a restatement of the conjecture.
proof-statement-integrity.notes: Repaired to 1a disposition 3 with the sum explicit. Two consequences the .md asserts in prose are now theorems rather than assertions: markovTrace_eq_zero_of_no_hyperbolic_pieces (empty piece set, the Seifert-fibered / pure-rotation case) and markovTrace_eq_zero_of_volumes_vanish (pieces present but all volume zero). Stated separately because an empty piece set and a set of volume-zero pieces are different geometric situations sharing a conclusion. So the JSJ grading now does work instead of being a name. Verdict major not critical: the identity remains conditional on the conjecture, which is correct and banner-declared, and the derivable consequences are derived. Still open: the conjecture, plus everything geometric - the Reeb bundle, the colour-tube closure K_beta, the JSJ decomposition, the Thurston volume, rho_F and the Markov trace are a finite index set and two functions the caller supplies. Verified lean-direct exit 0. Bean qou-z9ws.

trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Proposition, read in full. All ten categories clean: the final dichotomy (pure-rotation 3-cycles give Seifert-fibered complements with V_hyp = 0, non-torus compositions give hyperbolic complements with positive volume) is genuine mathematical content, not manufactured contrast; no dashes, triples, closers, warmth or meta-commentary. SS3b-cond CHECK PASSED, and this is worth recording because it is the one propagation-sensitive block in my batch: it is a provable-kind block whose uses[] contains conj:mass-volume-factorization, and it carries the required explicit conditional banner as its first line, 'Proposition (conditional on conj:mass-volume-factorization)'. Items 3 and 4 of SS3b-cond are therefore satisfied (items 1, 2 and 5 need the Lean class, which I did not open). The formula's shape also matches the framework's canonical volume-times-density form.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: TWO NOTES. (1) TYPE MISMATCH LEFT UNQUALIFIED. The left side tr_M(rho(beta)) is a Laurent-polynomial-valued algebraic quantity in q, while the right side is a sum of real Thurston volumes weighted by Frobenius packing densities. The identity can only typecheck after an archimedean evaluation, and the block never says 'at q_0' -- it states an unqualified equality. Given the substrate wall discipline this should name the evaluation, or state that rho_F carries the q-dependence. (2) THE PROSE DROPS THE WEIGHT. 'Its value equals the hyperbolic volume of its complement' omits the rho_F(P_i) factors and the JSJ sum that the display carries, so the sentence claims something strictly stronger and simpler than the proposition. Proposed fix: 'Its value equals the density-weighted sum of the hyperbolic volumes of its complement's JSJ pieces.'
